task: ADR_015 Section 10 amendment: tenant-scoped operator enrollment + demo isolation (closes two re-panel CRITICAL/privesc defects)

defects_closed.name: demo-door self-enroll
defects_closed.description: POST /v1/demo/session called enrollOperator(pubkeyHex, 'demo-session') writing the ONE global enrollment record (no tenant scope, no source scope). The route is mounted unauthenticated. Any caller self-enrolled into the production-trusted set and reopened Attack A through the demo door. Worst on fresh deploy: the demo route was the only enroll path, so the attacker wins the TOFU race.
defects_closed.root_cause: enrollOperator had no tenant_id parameter; enrollment was modeled as a single global act.
defects_closed.failing_before: Attacker POSTs /v1/demo/session -> enrolled globally -> updateGrantPredicate on a real tenant's grant SUCCEEDS (grant updated). 0 passed, 2 failed (oa_demo_door).
defects_closed.green_after: Demo enroll lands in the demo tenant (tenant:demo-{operator_oid}) with enrollment_source='demo-session'. assertEnrolledOperator requires tenant_id match AND enrollment_source!='demo-session' for non-demo tenants. Real-tenant grant update throws InvalidOperatorSignatureError. 2 passed, 0 failed (oa_demo_door).

defects_closed.name: global tenant-agnostic allowlist
defects_closed.description: assertEnrolledOperator took no tenant_id. The membership check was operator_oid===entry.operator_oid && status==='active'. An operator enrolled for any tenant authorized against EVERY tenant. The grant path enforced prior.tenant_id===input.tenant_id at the grant-load level (returns 'grant not found' for cross-tenant grant OIDs), but an operator enrolled for tenant-A could authorize any grant in tenant-B when the caller passes tenant-B as input.tenant_id.
defects_closed.root_cause: Same as Defect 1: single global enrollment record, no tenant binding on the membership check.
defects_closed.failing_before: Operator enrolled for tenant:alpha could call updateGrantPredicate with tenant_id='tenant:beta' and grant in tenant:beta -> grant updated. 0 passed, 2 failed (oa_cross_tenant second sub-case).
defects_closed.green_after: assertEnrolledOperator now takes tenant_id as first arg. Step-2 membership requires entry.tenant_id===tenant_id AND (isDemoTenant||entry.enrollment_source!=='demo-session'). Cross-tenant attempt throws OperatorNotEnrolledForTenantError -> wrapped as InvalidOperatorSignatureError. 2 passed, 0 failed (oa_cross_tenant).

run_evidence.note: All Section 10.5 reject-tests GREEN: oa_demo_door, oa_cross_tenant (both sub-cases), oa_demo_source, oa_firstrun_race, oa_attack_a regression, oa_grant_attack_a regression.
All Section 9 vectors stay GREEN after migration. oa_replay now gets 404 (not 403) on second decide after action consumed (correct). Migrated _testEnrollOperatorForTest calls to use OP_LOCAL_TENANT.

demo-revoke migration: demo route enrolls with source 'demo-session' into demo tenant. Demo grant update (updateGrantPredicate via demo router) authorizes for demo tenant (tenant:demo-*) which permits demo-session entries. All cases GREEN.
NODE_ENV=production hard-wall intact. _testEnrollOperatorForTest now takes tenant_id+source with defaults; production guard fires before any param processing.

vectors.name: oa-demo-door-enroll-scoped-to-demo-tenant
vectors.status_runner: tsx-backed GREEN 2026-06-23 (4 assertions, test/oa-tenant-scope.test.ts oa_demo_door block)
vectors.failing_before: Attacker POSTs /v1/demo/session -> enrollOperator wrote global record (no tenant_id) -> updateGrantPredicate on real-tenant grant SUCCEEDED. Grant updated by attacker.
vectors.description: Defect 1 (CRITICAL): unauthenticated demo enroll must NOT create a production-trusted entry. enrollOperator: new signature enrollOperator(tenant_id, pubkeyHex, deviceLabel, opts?). Guards per-tenant for non-demo sources. Demo-session source is idempotent.
assertEnrolledOperator: new first arg tenant_id. Step-2 membership requires entry.tenant_id===tenant_id AND (isDemoTenant||entry.enrollment_source!=='demo-session').
demo-router.ts line ~471: enrollOperator(tenant_id, operator_pubkey_hex, 'demo-session', {source:'demo-session'}) -- demo tenant only.
engine.ts line ~455: assertEnrolledOperator(prior.tenant_id, ...) -- passes grant's own tenant.

updateGrantPredicate on real-tenant grant using demo-enrolled key throws InvalidOperatorSignatureError

vectors.name: demo-tenant-grants-still-update-with-demo-session-source
vectors.status_runner: tsx-backed GREEN 2026-06-23 (11/11 test/demo-revoke.test.ts, includes grant-update case 6)
vectors.description: ADR_015 Section 10.2.B: the demo route keeps working as a product. The source clause (enrollment_source!=='demo-session') is ONLY applied for non-demo tenants (tenant_id does NOT start with 'tenant:demo-').
